decisions.reason: As an incremental core rye bread using familiar recipes, production routines and channels, it likely remains because no clear below-aspiration signal is visible and carrying costs are low.
The premium raisin stollen should stay because it is a flagship product and its award recognition indicates performance comfortably above the firm's aspiration level.
This seeded rye mixed bread fits the established assortment closely, so with no reported shortfall management would continue it under normal organisational slack.
The dark barley malt rye bread is somewhat more niche and overlapping with other rye loaves, but in a growing market it is still more likely to be retained unless comparative sales disappoint.

Ancient grain bread remains the most experimental item, yet because it builds on existing baking capabilities and no definite failure is observed, boundedly rational management is likely to extend the trial rather than withdraw it immediately.
